description: pyxccd cold_detect (lam 20 and lam 0) on synthetic seven-band series with known breaks. Coefficients are also given in the convention of GPURasterCOLDMonitor; see the generator.

cases.name: two-breaks
cases.note: A disturbance at slice 55 and a recovery at slice 110.

cases.name: small-break
cases.note: A disturbance a quarter the size of the others at slice 90. The first window and the window after the break pass the stability test only when the larger of the two end residuals is used.

cases.name: flagged-clouds
cases.note: A disturbance at slice 70 with 18 cloud (4) and 2 shadow (2) observations flagged in QA and 2 water (1) observations, which pyxccd keeps.

cases.name: unflagged-cloud-first-window
cases.note: A disturbance at slice 85 and an unflagged cloud at slice 6, inside the first window. pyxccd removes it with Tmask.

cases.name: four-consecutive
cases.note: A disturbance at slice 100, confirmed by 4 observations.

cases.name: gradual-change
cases.note: A linear transition over slices 70 to 100. The confirmed date depends on the refit schedule, the temporally adjusted RMSE and LASSO.
